sloka: वाक्यैस्तु खलु मर्माणि मम भूयो निकृन्तसि ।सुमन्त्रः करुणम् श्रुत्वा द्Rष्ट्वा दीनम् च पार्थिवम् ॥२-१४-६०॥
transliteration: vākyaistu khalu marmāṇi mama bhūyo nikṛntasi ।sumantraḥ karuṇam śrutvā dRṣṭvā dīnam ca pārthivam ॥2-14-60॥

translations.english: Having heard the sorrowful words of the king and having seen his wretched state Sumantra with palms folded moved away a little from the place.
